Compose a centered full-body frame with clean concrete lines, brushed-metal rails, tall frosted windows, natural daylight, and long precise shadows on the stairs. Preserve a clean, minimal environment, cinematic fashion-editorial composition, and realistic fabric, concrete, and metal textures.
